items.stem: An FP&A partner is asked only to 'explain the variance'. What makes the commentary decision-useful?

options.text: Identify the business cause and recommend an action, not just the number
options.rationale: Correct: decision-useful commentary links the variance to a cause and an action.

options.text: Restate the variance amount in words
options.rationale: That repeats the number without insight.

options.text: List every line item that moved
options.rationale: Volume is not insight; it buries the cause.
Attribution without evidence is not analysis.

items.explanation: Correct: decision-useful commentary links the variance to a cause and an action.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO inputs most improve a driver-based forecast over a line-item budget? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Operational drivers such as units, price and conversion rates
options.rationale: Correct: drivers connect the model to the business.

options.text: A rolling forecast horizon updated with actuals
options.rationale: Correct: rolling updates keep the forecast current.

options.text: Simply copying last year and adding a percentage
options.rationale: That ignores the drivers of change.

options.text: Hiding assumptions so the number looks firm
options.rationale: Opaque assumptions reduce trust and usefulness.

items.explanation: Correct: operational drivers and a rolling, actuals-updated horizon make the forecast more accurate and useful.

items.stem: A sponsor's business case shows only an optimistic base case. What should the FP&A partner add?

options.text: Scenario and sensitivity analysis showing the downside
options.rationale: Correct: scenarios expose the risk in a single-point estimate.

options.text: A larger font for the NPV
options.rationale: Presentation does not address the risk.
Hiding assumptions is the opposite of good practice.

options.text: A higher growth rate to improve the NPV
options.rationale: Inflating inputs is not objective analysis.

items.explanation: Correct: scenarios and sensitivities expose the risk hidden in a single base case.
